text.7:8: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.
text.7:187: They ask thee of the (destined) Hour, when will it come to port. Say: Knowledge thereof is with my Lord only. He alone will manifest it at its proper time. It is heavy in the heavens and the earth. It cometh not to you save unawares. They question thee as if thou couldst be well informed thereof. Say: Knowledge thereof is with Allah only, but most of mankind know not.
text.23:102: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
